title: feat: serve /v1/systemone as an alias of /alpha/decisions
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Added POST /v1/systemone as an alias for TypeSafe decisions on /alpha/decisions. Clients that append /v1/systemone to a base URL can use gen.pollinations.ai with the same request and response shape, model handling, key permissions, caching, and usage tracking. /alpha/decisions remains available; the two paths have separate cache keys, so sending the same request to both produces two generations. Added the alias to the OpenAPI and text-generation docs.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, and a nostalgic, emotionally warm feel.
